intent: Apply the absolute field-reality doctrine to end-of-shift reporting: preserve record truth, separate verified facts from contemporaneous judgment and unknowns, and expose the operational cost of concise, synchronized, or timeline-first reporting.
record_floor: Do not backfill facts, times, confirmations, or wording that did not exist at the time.
Document synchronization may link existing records and later change history, but must not rewrite historical source records as if later knowledge existed earlier.
Separate verified fact, contemporaneous judgment, role-specific statement, and still-unverified information.
presentation_rules: Treat worker, foreman, construction-team and safety-team accounts as evidence to preserve, not automatically as identical to verified fact.
Show speed, readability, relationship and evidence costs for every route.
Do not label timeline preservation as a frictionless correct answer; it costs time, coordination, and exposure of disagreement.
At 17:08 change the same panel from evidence-check focus to the actual record consequence.
